method.referenceChecks: CDC, Extended BMI-for-age growth charts: data files (four worked examples) and Child and teen BMI categories (one worked example); every percentile and z-score column of both data files
method.lms: z = ((BMI / M)^L - 1) / (L S); BMI = M (1 + L S z)^(1 / L) (CDC 2000 growth charts)
method.extended: Above the 95th percentile: percentile = 90 + 10 Phi((BMI - P95) / sigma); z = Phi^-1(percentile / 100) (CDC 2022 Extended BMI-for-age)
method.age: Completed months plus 0.5 selects the row; ages 2 through 19 years only
method.normal: Python statistics.NormalDist for Phi and its inverse
